records.text: Pioneer Group is a week in with no project yet, worth a nudge at this point

records.subject: Anything I can help with?
records.body:
Hi Wei,

Quick note to see how things are going. A lot of teams get stuck at the same step -- inviting teammates -- so if that's where you are, happy to walk through it.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.subject: A better way to track team projects
records.body:
Hi Wei,

A quick nudge: Wrenfield works best once your team's actual tasks are in it. If you've been meaning to set that up, today's as good a day as any.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Pioneer Group
records.body:
Hi Wei,

Welcome to Wrenfield! Your workspace is ready. A good first step is to create your first project and invite a teammate.

If anything's unclear, just reply here.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Six days in, no first project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero replies to three outbound touches (email:c03aedb8, email:e4660b3c, email:6321728a). No tickets, so no engagement signal at all. Starter plan, 8 days left; silent accounts rarely self-activate.

draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Wei,

I know a few notes from us have landed in your inbox already, so I'll keep this one short.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so getting one project in place is usually the step that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to work through that first project with you and answer anything about how your team would use it.

Best,
Chidi
